summary: Version the frozen sixteen-candidate simplification execution plan into docs/plans/system-simplification-20260906/, publish the initial dependency-coverage disposition ledger with status explicitly planned, and reconcile the frozen inventory counts against current Pantheon dev and execute-plans dev.
verification_note: diff -q against each source packet file returned no differences, and a fresh sha256sum of each committed copy matches both the source packet file and the sourceRefs sha256 recorded on the task's canonical dev_bridge.documents row.

disposition_ledger.generated_from: oss-version-task-coverage.csv (frozen packet supply, sha256 44657ecc44e854920f34584f96be2868e192634d231ceea19790490ca9637ab5, matches dev_bridge source_ref)
disposition_ledger.transform: appended a status column set to the literal value 'planned' for every row; no disposition, task_id, or inventory value was rewritten

reconciliation_against_current_dev.method: For each inventory category, counted the same signal directly in the current worktree (Pantheon task branch task/OSS-COVERAGE-PLAN-001 at 55cd327b9200648e5d42360907dedc17ddf6f5fc, cut from dev) and, for npm, in the sibling execute-plans dev checkout at 4fd6088d5478d32911029628d5047b5e37c6bbdf, then compared to the frozen packet counts.

pypi_declaration_rows.note: Two apparent extra lines in services/research/finrl/requirements.txt and services/research/rllib/requirements.txt were --extra-index-url directives, not package declarations; excluding those, current matches frozen exactly.

requirements_files.note: 46 files carry at least one pypi_declaration row; the remaining 3 (services/research/requirements.txt, services/research/dspy/requirements.txt, services/research/imitation/requirements.txt) are the forwarding/comment-only files called out in the task acceptance and correctly carry zero declaration rows.

image_declaration_rows.note: 49 Dockerfile FROM lines + 14 docker-compose*.yml image: lines across the current Pantheon worktree.

reconciliation_against_current_dev.conclusion: No new current-dev declarations were discovered outside the frozen packet inventory; the frozen oss-version-task-coverage.csv rows remain a complete and current cover of the audit inventory, so no additional rows were appended to the disposition ledger beyond the frozen set plus the new status column.

scope_boundary.note: This task versions and publishes the plan/coverage documents and the initial planned-status disposition ledger. It does not implement any OSS upgrade, LLM replacement, or retirement candidate; those are separate family tasks (OSS-CORE-BASELINE-001, OSS-TOOLING-BASELINE-001, OSS-RESEARCH-FOOTPRINT-001, OSS-RESEARCH-BASELINE-001, OSS-EXECUTION-BASELINE-001, FE-DEP-CLOSURE-001, FE-TOOLCHAIN-BASELINE-001, FE-UI-DEPS-BASELINE-001, OSS-INFRA-CHOICE-001, OSS-INFRA-PROFILES-001, OSS-OBJECT-STORE-CUTOVER-001, SIMPLIFY-OPENCLAW-001, SIMPLIFY-EXTRACTION-001, SIMPLIFY-RETRIEVAL-MEMORY-001, SIMPLIFY-BFF-RESIDUAL-001, FE-QUERY-CACHE-001, OPS-LEGACY-REVIEW-RETIRE-001, SYS-SIMPLIFY-IMPLEMENTATION-CLOSURE-001) listed with their own owner/reviewer/dependency graph in tasks.json and COVERAGE.md. No credentials, accounts, quotas, model settings, or slot counts were changed.

python3 -c "..." to append the status=planned column to oss-version-disposition.csv (447 rows, 0 unassigned task_id)
